blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The verified deployed AssetToken overrides burnFrom(account, amount) with onlyBurner and directly calls _burn without an allowance check. Core governors can grant BURNER_ROLE, and CoreRef.setCore(address) is onlyGovernor. At Ethereum block 26095797, token core() returned 0xb2799ed78490ea642d2ecb23cb2ce9b8acc087d4 and its GOVERN_ROLE still had Core plus two EOA members. The adverse reviewedStatus=true is retained for privileged holder-balance destruction and replaceable access authority; this is not a claim that an address-blacklist mapping exists.

oracleRisk.summary: USDR is minted by Core-authorized accounts rather than borrower collateral positions; its verified deployed token and current minter set expose no collateral-price liquidation branch.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: The verified USDR AssetToken mint path accepts only an account and amount, and the reviewed Core roles expose no collateral-ratio gate, reserve-ratio input, oracle call, NAV, exchange-rate quote, or liquidation engine. At finalized Ethereum block 25531699 on 2026-07-14, the current minter set was three EOAs and RingLaunchpad; the launchpad only deploys generic tokens and seeds AMM liquidity. The PCV/bonding-curve description is not tied to a price-sensitive authority in the tracked USDR issuance path, so not-applicable remains correct.
